name: GigaChat (Sber)
description: GigaChat is a family of Russian language models from Sber. Requires OAuth authentication and a custom CA bundle (Russian Trusted Root CA).
author: PELDRUN Community

connection_fields.label: Authorization Key
connection_fields.description: From the Sber Studio dashboard. This is the 'Authorization key' for your GigaChat app. Format: base64(client_id + ':' + client_secret).

connection_fields.label: Account Scope
connection_fields.description: Which Sber API scope to authenticate against. B2B/CORP require a contract with Sber.

connection_fields.label: Russian Root CA Bundle
connection_fields.description: B2B and CORP scopes use a different CA that certifi does not include. Required for those scopes. Download from https://gu-st.ru/content/Other/doc/russiantrustedca.pem

connection_fields.label: Verify SSL Certificates
connection_fields.description: Disable ONLY for development against a local mock server.

certificates.description: The Russian Trusted Root CA is required for GigaChat's TLS connections. It is not included in the standard certifi trust store shipped with Python.
certificates.issuer: Ministry of Digital Development of the Russian Federation
